label: Sample Villains & Minions
description: The original Glass Meridian network: a private intelligence broker, three lieutenants and eight reusable minion profiles.

cast.name: Vera Kestrel — The Glass Broker
cast.description: Vera runs Glass Meridian, a shipping consultancy that sells stolen identities and routes sensitive cargo through legitimate contracts. She wants a ledger recovered before it connects her clients to a vanished courier.
cast.behavior: Offers useful intelligence to split the team, lets her lieutenants negotiate first, and retreats through a service exit when her cover collapses.
cast.customization: Choose the courier's secret, the client Vera fears and the evidence that could turn her staff against her.

cast.name: Anton Rusk — Security Chief
cast.description: Anton protects Vera and maintains the network's safehouses. He believes the consultancy shields witnesses from dangerous clients, and has not seen the full ledger.
cast.behavior: Keeps a route open for his principal, uses cover and demands that intruders put their weapons down before he negotiates.
cast.customization: Decide which innocent employee Anton protects and what evidence would convince him to stand aside.

cast.name: Leila Sayegh — Signal Keeper
cast.description: Leila controls Glass Meridian's access logs and remote cameras. She has hidden a private copy of the courier's last transmission as insurance against Vera.
cast.behavior: Locks doors, redirects guards with false alerts and bargains for a safe exit once the agents reach her workstation.
cast.customization: Choose where her backup lives and who she needs extracted before she will surrender it.

cast.name: Milo Vale — Retrieval Leader
cast.description: Milo retrieves missing shipments and silences loose ends. Recovering the courier's ledger would let him buy control of the operation from Vera's rivals.
cast.behavior: Sends scouts ahead, isolates the ledger's carrier and withdraws once he has the objective rather than fighting to the last person.
cast.customization: Choose his rival buyer, extraction route and price for abandoning Vera.
